Privacy Policy

Last Updated: July 22, 2026

Welcome to the Logos Church, Nepal mobile and web application (the "App"). We respect your privacy and are committed to protecting the personal data you share with us. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, store, and protect your information when you use our App.

1. Information We Collect

To provide a functional and collaborative experience for our church community, we collect the following types of information:

  • Account Information: When you sign up or log in (via Email or Google Sign-In), we collect your name, email address, and profile photo/avatar.
  • User-Generated Content: Any content you choose to share in the App, including prayer requests, comments on prayer requests, podcasts, news articles (contributors/admins only), and chat messages (text, photos, or videos).
  • Push Notification Tokens: We collect and store Firebase Cloud Messaging (FCM) tokens to deliver push notifications about church announcements, prayer requests, podcast updates, live worships, and chat messages.

2. How We Use Your Information

We use the collected information for the following purposes:

  • To authenticate your identity and secure your access to the App.
  • To enable community sharing, group messaging, and prayer support within the church.
  • To send push notifications for updates you opt-in to receive. You can customize these notifications in your App settings.
  • To facilitate the uploading, hosting, and playback of spiritual content (sermons, worship streams, and podcasts).

3. Service Providers & Data Hosting

Your data is processed and stored securely using Google Firebase services. Specifically:

  • Firebase Authentication: Manages sign-up, sign-in, and account security.
  • Cloud Firestore: Stores user profiles, chat metadata, announcements, and prayer requests.
  • Firebase Cloud Storage: Hosts media files (images, audio, videos) uploaded by users.
  • Firebase Cloud Messaging (FCM): Dispatches push notifications to your devices.

We do not sell, trade, or rent your personal information to third parties. We only share data with service providers to the extent necessary to run the App functions.

4. Data Retention and Account Deletion

We retain your personal data and community content for as long as your account is active. You have full control over your data:

  • Account Deletion: You can permanently delete your account and all associated profile data at any time from within the App. Go to Settings → Delete Account.
  • Data Deletion Impact: When you delete your account, your user profile, authentication records, and individual settings are permanently erased from our databases. Chat messages and comments you posted will no longer be associated with your identity and will show as from a "Deleted User" or be removed, where applicable.

5. Children's Privacy

Our App is intended for members of the church community. We do not knowingly collect personal information from children without parental guidance and consent. If we learn we have collected personal data from a child under 13 without appropriate consent, we will delete it immediately.

6. Changes to This Policy

We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. When we make changes, we will update the "Last Updated" date at the top of this page. We encourage you to review this policy periodically.

7. Contact Us

If you have any questions, feedback, or concerns regarding your privacy or data deletion, please contact us at:
